title: Environment Chain Setup and Initial State
description: An Environment class with parent links forms a chain. The global frame defines total, and an empty inner frame links to it.
source: draft: vibe free model + check fix: claude

steps.description: The Environment class stores vars in a dict and follows parent links to look up names.
assign walks the chain to update an existing binding, while define writes only to the current frame.
__repr__ prints each frame's name and vars, then recurses to the parent to show the full chain.
glob defines total as 0, then inner is created with glob as its parent and no vars of its own.

steps.question: What string does inner print as

steps.description: The start section prints the chain representation of inner.
Running prints === Start === followed by inner:{} -> global:{'total': 0}.
The after section prints both inner and glob representations.
